newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy's Omnitel has operating profit since April.
newsitem.headline: Italy's Omnitel has operating profit since April.

text.p: - Italian mobile phone operator Omnitel, in which Olivetti has a dominant stake, has been running an operating profit since April this year, the company's Finance Director Pietro Guindani said on Thursday.

He told a news conference the company aimed to achieve break-even for the year as a whole on earnings before interest, tax depreciation and amortisation. It would not achieve break-even on cash-flow until 1999.
Omnitel also said that it had renegotiated an existing 10-year project financing facility of 1.8 trillion lire, raising the amount to 2.8 trillion lire.
Four banks had arranged the loan -- BCI, Chase Manhattan JP Morgan and Union Bank of Switzerland -- which will help meet the company's financing needs until it breaks even on cash-flow.
Omnitel, Italy's second operator of digital GSM phones, said earlier in the week it had 1.254 million customers at the end of the first half of 1997, a fourfold increase from a year earlier.
